issuing_authority_en: Board of the Capital Market Authority
legal_basis: نظام الشركات الصادر بالمرسوم الملكي رقم (م/132) وتاريخ 1/12/1443هـ
legal_basis_en: Companies Law issued by Royal Decree No. M/132 dated 1/12/1443 AH
source_scope: listed joint-stock companies / شركات المساهمة المدرجة
source_scope_note: This is a SPECIALIZED implementing regulation for listed joint-stock companies only, NOT a general implementing regulation for all Companies Law entities.
extraction_method: curl fetch of Umm Al-Qura official page + HTML parsing
uncertainty_notes: Text extracted from the official Umm Al-Qura gazette page. The regulation was originally issued under Companies Law M/3 (1437H) and amended under Companies Law M/132 (1443H). This is the amended version as published on 1448-1-18 AH / 03-07-2026. The regulation is specialized to listed joint-stock companies and is NOT a general implementing regulation for all Companies Law entities.
